story.text: Everyone climbs out of the pool, dripping wet. The best thing to get them dry, says the Dodo, is a {CAUCUS} {RACE}: they all run round in a {CIRCLE}, starting and stopping whenever they like. After half an hour the {DODO} declares, “{EVERYBODY} has won, and all must have {PRIZES}!” Alice hands round her {COMFITS}, and the Dodo solemnly presents her with her own {THIMBLE}.
story.caption: We beg your acceptance of this elegant thimble
